rules.description: Applications that may require changes to crucial information must undergo two-stage verification.
rules.condition: When an application involves changes/modification/alteration in crucial information such as bank account or course fee.
rules.outcome: The application must be first verified by the concerned Institute/School and then by the District/State authority before being sent for Lot generation.
rules.evidence_quote: Since, all such applications may require changes / modification / alteration in crucial information such as bank account / course fee etc., it require two-stage verification i.e. will be first verified by the concerned Institute/School and thereafter, by the next verifying authority District/State before being sent for Lot generation.

rules.description: Renewal applications are made available to the Institute/School for verification immediately after submission on the portal.
rules.condition: For renewal applications when the application is made on the Portal.
rules.outcome: The Institute/School can begin verification as soon as the application is made available.
rules.evidence_quote: A renewal application will be made available to the Institute/School for verification as soon as the application is made on the Portal.

rules.description: The first stage verification for renewal applications must be completed by 31st August 2017.
rules.condition: For renewal cases during the first stage verification at Institute/School level.
rules.evidence_quote: For renewal cases the first stage verification i.e. at the Institute/School level shall be completed by 31st August, 2017

rules.description: The second stage verification for renewal applications should be completed by 30th September 2017.
rules.condition: For renewal cases during the second stage verification.
rules.evidence_quote: and the second stage verification may be completed by 30th September, 2017.
